_README: Lab B144 ground truth for the 8 HM01B0 bench captures in out/cam_snap/snaps/*.raw.
LABELLED BY EYE from the demosaiced, 180-rotated renders. The FILENAMES ENCODE THE OLD
MODEL'S WRONG GUESSES and are NOT labels -- every one of the 8 is wrong.
Coordinates are pixels in the 324x324 frame AFTER rot180 (the camera is mounted upside
down; IMAGE_ORIENTATION 0x0101 is measured not to flip this part, see CAMERA_Z1.md 9.5).
box is [x0,y0,x1,y1] drawn to the outer edge of the sign's red boundary.
Truth: 5 STOP, 3 YIELD. The props are US-style: red octagon lettered STOP, and a
point-down white triangle with a thick red border lettered YIELD.
